name: Council of Chalcedon
coreDoctrines: Christ is one person in two natures
Christ is fully divine and fully human
the two natures are united without confusion or division
the incarnation is central to salvation
guardsAgainst: blending Christ's divinity and humanity into confusion
minimizing either Christ's humanity or divinity
discernmentQuestions: Does this honor both the divinity and humanity of Christ?
Does it keep incarnation and salvation together?
Does it avoid making Jesus merely symbolic or merely human?
